candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit condition from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit (allows equal to MinDeposit to be accepted).
Change the deposit condition from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value > MinDeposit && msg.value != 0 (adds redundant nonzero check that can change behavior for zero-value calls).
Remove the require overflow check so balances can be updated without the require guard (potentially different behavior if overflow ever occurred).
Move the balances increment to occur before the require check (could revert due to require but changes state/update ordering and observable balances if require is removed later).
Change the balances update to add only MinDeposit instead of msg.value (caps deposited amount to MinDeposit).
